t: A five-day middle school AI package on training data, bias, and generative AI.
steps: Find the Rutgers Introduction to AI package from the Center for Effective School Practices.
Download the lesson plan, educator guide, and slides.
Read the educator guide on privacy and district policy.
Ask IT to approve Quick, Draw! and AI for Oceans.
Pick an approved generative AI tool for the book cover project.
Test the tools on a student device.
